title: Surat police bust alleged illegal investment call centre in Indore, five arrested
date_note: The IANS report is dated 24 November and gives no earlier date for the raid.
org: Surat City Police Cyber Crime Branch
place: Surat, Gujarat (police); call centre in Indore, Madhya Pradesh
geo_basis: Surat City Police, the agency that ran the operation; the call centre was in Indore
summary: IANS reports that Surat City Police's Cyber Crime Branch busted an alleged illegal call centre in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, and arrested five people. Police also recovered data relating to 3,079 customers from different states, and investigators traced transactions worth more than Rs 8.22 crore through 12 bank accounts linked to the operation.
plain: Police in Surat raided a suspected illegal call centre in Indore and arrested five people. They say they recovered data relating to 3,079 customers from different states.
exec: Police traced transactions worth more than Rs 8.22 crore through 12 bank accounts linked to an alleged illegal call centre.
action: Police advise victims to contact the national cybercrime helpline, 1930, immediately so money in the receiving accounts has a better chance of being frozen.

evidence.quote: Police also recovered data relating to 3,079 customers from different states across the country.
investigators have traced transactions worth more than Rs 8.22 crore through 12 bank accounts linked to the operation.

validation.note: Single publisher (IANS, hosted on Prokerala); relays the police statement.

review.note: Compared five arrests, 3,079 customers, Rs 8.22 crore, 12 accounts, 1930 advice against IANS/Prokerala
